public_rationale: Other outlets did report approximately $4.3 billion for the first half. That does not settle cumulative revenue through September. TechCrunch's independent source says the leaked Microsoft payments were net of reciprocal revenue sharing, so they cannot directly establish OpenAI's total revenue. This identifies a weakness in the $4.5 billion inference, but does not provide a matching total that proves it false.
limitations: News reporting was used because matching primary financial records were not obtained.
A flawed inference is not itself proof that the stated amount is wrong.
The first-half reporting component is corroborated, but remains context because its period differs.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's revenues were around $4.5 billion by the end of September 2025, a vast difference from the $4.3 billion for the first half of the year published by other outlets.

statement.excerpt: which also includes evidence that OpenAI's revenues were at around $4.5 billion by the end of September, a vast difference from the $4.3 billion for the first half of the year published by other outlets.

from_speaker: $4.3 billion for the first half of the year published by other outlets
our_interpretation: Read the main amount as cumulative realized revenue from January 1 through September 30, 2025.
The basis is estimate because the assertion derives from reporting and documents rather than a stated accounting standard.
The ordinary reading is total company revenue, before treating a commercial partner's net settlement as the company's revenue.
'Around' permits rounding and modest estimation differences; no precise tolerance was supplied.
The first-half figure is a separate statement about reporting. It cannot itself establish nine-month revenue.
'By the end of September' specifies the observation period, not a conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Independent evidence measuring cumulative OpenAI revenue through September 2025 on the same basis places it around $4.5 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Independent evidence measuring the same nine-month revenue on the same basis places it materially outside an ordinary approximation to $4.5 billion.
